featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place with my friends after hearing a lot about it, and it truly lived up to the expectations. We had a fantastic experience—both the food and the overall vibe were excellent.

We ordered Bombil fry as a starter, along with Prawns Thali and Surmai Thali. Every single dish was 10/10. Personally, whenever I try a new place for fish, I judge it by the taste of the Bombil fry—and this one was outstanding. It was extremely fresh, perfectly crispy, and the masala was well balanced and nicely blended.

The same quality and freshness reflected in the Surmai and Prawns thali—authentic taste and very satisfying portions.

On the owner’s suggestion, we also tried their Mutton Thali for a change, and it was surprisingly excellent. The mutton was fresh, tender, and full of flavour, which is rare to find these days.

If you’re a seafood lover, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy quality fish with great taste and vibes.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: Arabian Dastar is a hidden gem for anyone craving authentic Arabian flavors. This cozy yet elegant spot delivers a feast that transports you straight to the heart of the Middle East. If you're in the mood to explore rich, aromatic, and flavorful dishes, this restaurant is your destination. From appetizers to desserts, Dastar offers an unforgettable experience with its menu full of traditional favorites. Here's a glimpse of what we tried and why you should too. The evening kicked off with a warm, comforting bowl of Shorba, a classic Arabian soup that sets the tone for the meal ahead. The broth was perfectly spiced, with delicate notes of cumin and cinnamon. With each spoonful, you could taste the depth of flavor and the smooth, velvety texture that only comes from hours of careful simmering. Served hot, it was the ideal starter, warming us up and preparing our palates for the upcoming dishes. Next up was the showstopper: the Turkey Roast Chicken. A twist on the traditional roasted chicken, this dish used turkey, marinated in a blend of Arabian spices and herbs. The turkey was tender, juicy, and roasted to perfection, its skin crisped to a beautiful golden-brown. The seasoning was a perfect balance of savory and aromatic, with hints of garlic, cumin, and coriander. Paired with a side of fresh vegetables and rice, this was a hearty and satisfying main course that stood out for its delicate yet bold flavors. If you're looking for a dish that embodies the soul of Arabian cuisine, the Omani Mandi is a must-try. This traditional rice dish is packed with flavor, where tender lamb (or chicken) is cooked with rice, saffron, and a blend of spices. At Dastar, the Mandi was perfectly cooked, with each grain of rice soaked in the rich, fragrant broth. The lamb was succulent, falling off the bone with ease. The dish was an aromatic masterpiece, with a hint of smokiness that comes from the traditional cooking method. It's a dish that speaks to the heart of Arabian comfort food. To wrap up our meal, we indulged in a classic Arabian dessert: Kunafa. This popular sweet is made from delicate strands of semolina dough, soaked in sugar syrup, and topped with melted cheese or cream. At Dastar, the Kunafa was served warm and gooey, with the perfect balance of sweetness and richness. The texture was spot-on: crispy on the outside and melt-in-your-mouth soft on the inside. The fragrant rosewater and the syrup provided just the right touch of sweetness, making it an unforgettable finish to the meal. Dastar Restaurant delivers an authentic Arabian dining experience with impeccable service and a menu that brings the best of the Middle East to your table. Whether you're new to Arabian food or a seasoned fan, their Shorba, Turkey Roast Chicken, Omani Mandi, and Kunafa will leave you craving more. Every dish was a testament to the skillful use of spices, and the flavors were rich, comforting, and full of character. If you're in the area, don't miss the chance to explore the vibrant tastes of Arabian cuisine at Dastar. You won’t be disappointed

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Raut (Vedanta)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Afghani Soya Chaap

Roaming around in the evening at Khau Galli in Ghatkopar if you feel a complete lack of non-vegetarian options then head straight to Seven Spices. A chicken lover on a vegetarian day should look for a soya chaap.  What an amazing replacement for chicken with similar taste and nutritional value. The Afghani Soya Chaap was creamy,  juicy and delectable.  The onions served along with it were freshly cut and retained its crunch.  The green chutney was sweet & spicy,  making it a best accompaniment along with the sweet and savoury Afghani Soya Chaap.  As it was our first time to taste it,  we ordered a half plate which is for 130/-rs with a decent quantity(as in the pic below).

If you like things in white creamy sauce,  you can try Malai soya chaap or Afghani one.  Apart from these they have many other options in soya chaap done with red tandoori spices.

The person on the counter was a shopkeeper with a smile and a welcoming attitude.Ask him for suggestions.

Go try it!  You wont regret.

Era 77 Restaurant – A Fresh Take on Flavor & Vibe

If you’re looking for a place that hits the sweet spot between style, flavor, and comfort, Era 77 is worth your time. From the moment you step in, the atmosphere feels both modern and inviting — with just the right mix of ambient lighting, cool decor, and good music that doesn’t overpower your conversation.

The menu is diverse without being overwhelming, with each dish clearly crafted with attention to detail. Their signature dishes, especially the Hummus platter or Lasagna ”hit bold flavors that stick with you. Portions are generous, presentation is on point, and the pricing feels fair for the quality.

The service stands out — warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful. Whether you're out for a relaxed dinner, a date night, or a chill catch-up with friends, Era 77 delivers on every front.
Great vibe, delicious food, and staff that makes you feel right at home. Definitely a spot to return to.

Review: ERA 77 Fusion Restaurant Café

ERA 77 Fusion Restaurant Café is a nice little spot located conveniently close to home, making it an easy choice for a relaxed outing. The place offers a vibrant atmosphere that suits all age groups—whether you're out with friends, family, or even just looking for a cozy hangout.

The ambiance is definitely one of its highlights—modern yet welcoming, with a good mix of music, lighting, and seating arrangements that make you want to sit back and enjoy your time.

However, one area that could use improvement is the service. The staff didn’t seem very responsive, and our order took longer than expected to arrive, which dampened the overall experience a bit.

With better service, this place has the potential to become a favorite hangout spot for many. Worth a visit for the ambiance, but be prepared for some waiting.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek
featured_reviews.review_text:
ERA 77 in Ghatkopar is a fantastic spot for both casual meetups with friends and a great choice for a first date. The ambiance strikes a fine balance between comfort and style, creating a warm and inviting vibe.

The food was consistently impressive — from starters to main course, every dish was thoughtfully prepared, rich in flavor, and beautifully presented.

What truly stood out were the beverages. The Brownie Shake was indulgent and satisfying, and the Masala Chase added just the right amount of spice and kick. Honestly, after trying both, it felt like a cure for any bad day — truly uplifting and mood-boosting.

If you're looking for delicious food, great drinks, and a feel-good atmosphere in Ghatkopar, ERA 77 is definitely worth a visit.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

If you’re a fan of authentic, well-made kulchas, Sai Kripa does not disappoint. Their kulchas are:

✅ Perfectly Crisp & Fluffy – The outer layer has a satisfying crispiness, while the inside remains soft and slightly chewy.

✅ Well-Stuffed & Flavorful – Whether it’s aloo, paneer, or mixed stuffing, they don’t skimp on ingredients. The masala is balanced, with a slight tang and spice kick that complements the kulcha beautifully.

✅ Served with the Right Pairings – A good kulcha is incomplete without chole, raita, or chutney, and Sai Kripa gets this right. Their chole is rich and well-spiced, making for a fulfilling combination.

✅ Good Portion & Value for Money – Generous portions at reasonable pricing make it a great choice for a hearty meal.

Overall, if you’re looking for a place that nails a classic North Indian-style kulcha, Sai Kripa is worth a visit.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

The Best Pure Veg Spot in Neelkanth Business Park!

Lark is my go-to spot whenever I’m at Neelkanth Business Park. It’s a perfect mix of great taste, hygiene, and a professional yet cozy vibe.

Here’s why it’s a must-visit:

Signature Dishes: You have to try the Pineapple Shira—it’s sweet, rich, and has real fruit bits. For snacks, the Lark Special Idli (loaded with dry fruits) and Idli Chilly Fry are absolutely delicious and perfectly spiced.

Multi-Cuisine Variety: Their menu is huge! From authentic South Indian breakfast to spicy Chinese and North Indian Sizzlers, everything is fresh and flavorful. The Kerala Appam with Stew is another hidden gem here.

Cleanliness & Ambience: The restaurant is very well-maintained. The washrooms are clean, and the seating is comfortable enough for a quick lunch or a long team dinner.

Budget-Friendly: Despite being in a premium business park, the prices are very reasonable for the quality and quantity they serve.

Convenience: Located on the ground floor, it’s super accessible for everyone working in the park or coming from Vidya Vihar station.

Verdict: 5/5 for service, taste, and cleanliness. Definitely the best pure veg option in the area!

featured_reviews.name: Sarbjeet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Naaz Family Restaurant – A Taste of Tradition | ★★★★☆ (4/5)

Humara Naaz, Kurla ka Swad!
Naaz Family Restaurant has been a beloved part of Kurla since 1968 – a true culinary landmark nestled conveniently near Phoenix Market City. Stepping into Naaz feels like stepping into a flavorful legacy passed down through generations.

What I Loved:

Authentic Flavors: Every bite spoke volumes about their time-honored recipes. You can taste the richness and tradition in each dish – it’s clear they've been perfecting their craft for decades.

Warm, Family Atmosphere: Despite the lively crowd, the place radiates warmth. It’s cozy, familiar, and perfect for a wholesome family meal.

Prime Location: Just a stone’s throw from Phoenix Market City, it’s easy to find. Their multiple contact numbers also reflect their efficiency with deliveries and takeaways.

What Could Be Better:

Food Consistency: While most dishes were excellent, I noticed slight variation in quality – possibly due to the high rush hours.

Crowded Seating: The place tends to get packed, especially during peak times. Better space management or a seating upgrade would go a long way.

Ambiance: The decor feels a bit dated. A little refresh could add charm without losing its traditional essence.

Final Thoughts:
If you're looking for authentic, flavorful comfort food served with a side of nostalgia, Naaz Family Restaurant is a must-visit. It’s a true reflection of Mumbai’s culinary heritage, and with a few small tweaks, it could easily shine even brighter.

customer_updates.text: If there’s a brand that embodies the safari gold standard, it’s Singita, which runs 19 lodges and camps across South Africa, Zimbabwe, Tanzania and Rwanda. Ebony Lodge, overlooking the Sand River in a private concession in the leopard-rich Sabi Sands Game Reserve, was the one that started it all, back in 1993. But in some ways Singita’s other lodges (we adore the nature-modernist Sweni lodge) had overtaken its traditional aesthetic—until a richly textured redesign led by Cape Town designers Cécile and Boyd was unveiled in spring 2024. The new Ebony Lodge—with the indoor-outdoor stepped central area that descends toward the river, and the glass and canvas that has replaced walls in the 12 richly textured suites—is more flowing, more immersed in nature. Singita’s game drives are always next-level, and for us, private sightings, like of a tree-bound leopard chillingly devouring an impala, were followed by blissful moments by our private plunge pool watching elephants loll in the riverbed. The new Ebony is smarter than ever but, happily, remains a classic.
